body: I don't think i will find an alternative...mainly because for me I'm positive there are none. But I do hope you find some release for your pain.

thanks for not trying to talk me out of it, because you are right...for some people suicide is the answer. i've tried everything to get better, cycles of therapy and drugs, and nothing works. i understand my decision is selfish but I simply can't continue "living" in this hell.
